# Sakura Crossing

The sakura skin draws its warm highlights, violet shadows and pink/green palette
from [Sakura Crossing](https://github.com/Kenton-GMI/sakura-crossing),
Copyright (c) 2026 Kenton Wang, licensed under MIT.
The full license is included in `sakura-crossing-LICENSE.txt`.

The railway, harbour and observatory illustrations in `build/skin-scenes.js` are
original SVG pixel scenes made for this site. They do not include the upstream
Three.js world or any upstream audio files. The site uses no additional runtime
dependencies for these skins.
